_: THE DESKTOP RAIL, which nothing has ever measured. Every other scenario is a phone at 390x844, and the rail down the left is what the stylesheet folds the bottom bar into above 768px — so a dozen buttons that only exist on a wide screen had never been compared against anything. This presses four of the rail's own: the knowledge store, the credit gauge, the shared calendars and the database export, which is last because it opens a modal. Harjoituspaikat is not among them — it replaces the whole screen, rail and all, and `more-sheet` already walks that page.
